title: Astronauts Return After Seven Months in Space
paragraphs: Four astronauts from the Crew-12 mission returned to Earth on 8 October 2026. They spent 237 days, more than seven months, on the International Space Station.

Their SpaceX Crew Dragon spaceship, called Freedom, landed in the Pacific Ocean near Los Angeles. The crew were Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway from NASA, Sophie Adenot from the European Space Agency and Andrey Fedyaev from Russia.

On the station, the crew did hundreds of hours of research, for example on stem cells and on making medical fluids in space. Meir did four spacewalks. Adenot did three and became the first French woman to walk outside the station.
